commands: SDK=${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}; echo '--- installed system images ---'; find "$SDK/system-images" -maxdepth 4 -type f -name package.xml -print | sort | while read f; do echo "### $f"; grep -E '<path>|<api-level>|<tag>|<abi>' "$f" | head -20; done; echo '--- avds ---'; "$SDK/emulator/emulator" -list-avds
